fix.action: Proactive alert and re-ship when a parcel stalls past the estimate; review carriers with the most stalled parcels
Pick and pack check for multi-unit orders; flag sellers who split shipments without telling the customer
Response time target for sellers; tracking code sent automatically at dispatch
Review the lowest rated products in the worst categories with their sellers
Variant (colour, size, voltage) check at packing for the sellers with the most wrong items
Set delivery estimates from real carrier times per route instead of a fixed promise
Clear return flow with a refund deadline
Listing audit for the worst categories: photos, materials, 'original' claims
Packaging standard for fragile categories; quality check sellers with repeat defect complaints
Combine shipping for multi-item orders from one seller
